epic: Epic 1 -- t27b codegen audit: find where the 656 ms is lost
machine: arm64 Mac, performance cores, warm cache, single process

top_losses.name: clamp branch chain for the saturating wrap
top_losses.fix: branchless saturating wrap: sub plus csel, no taken branch

top_losses.name: call crossing not inlined
top_losses.fix: inline a pure, non-recursive callee under an instruction budget

top_losses.name: u64 overflow checks on every add
top_losses.fix: prove the bound or drop the check in a speed tier; keep it in the safe tier

top_losses.name: loop-invariant limit rebuilt every iteration
top_losses.fix: hoist invariant materialisation out of the loop into a callee-saved register

top_losses.name: entry register shuffling
top_losses.fix: coalesce argument copies at entry; no runtime effect on this workload

registry_hypothesis_killed.hypothesis: the hot loop pays for loads and stores, so register allocation is the biggest win
registry_hypothesis_killed.evidence: loads 0, stores 0, spills 0 in 0x54..0xa4; everything already lives in x19..x22
registry_hypothesis_killed.consequence: reorder the ladder: control flow before register allocation

verdict.to_zig_rung: 21 -> 6 instructions projects 187 ms at constant IPC; removing a call and a taken branch raises IPC, so 150 ms sits at the edge of the scalar path, not beyond it
verdict.therefore: NEON stays last and becomes margin, not a precondition
